parameters.name: account
parameters.description: Fully qualified account name, for example `firms/YOUR_FIRM/accounts/YOUR_ACCOUNT`.

get.description: Read the maker fee tier and the taker fee tier of an account. Requires a bearer token with read:accounts scope; no x-participant-id header is needed. Returns 400 when account is missing or is not a valid account name, and 403 when the caller is not permitted to trade the account, also for an account that does not exist.

makerTier.description: Maker fee tier of the account, from 1 to 9. Tier 1 is the default tier.

takerTier.description: Taker fee tier of the account, from 1 to 9. Tier 1 is the default tier.
